form_factors.normalization: raw F1uds,F2uds divided by 3 once for external gVN=3*gVq

quadrature_rule: tensor-product Gauss-Hermite with exp(-x^2) weight; shifted HO momenta p_i=k-q_A/2, p_f=k+q_A/2
model: AFH HO momentum-space orbitals embedded into positive-energy free Dirac spinors; finite-tN Borah2020 proton/neutron EM plus Sufian2017 unit-strange F1,F2; qN=qA, tN=tA; exact-current vertex q0 uses external energy prescription; leading-NR control uses external ER
